entities.name: FRMD8
observations: The 471-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Danio rerio FERM domain-containing protein 8 (UniProt E7F221).
FRMD8 contains a FERM_M domain at residues 137–273 and a KRIT1_FRMD8_FERM_C domain at residues 292–367, based on Pfam scanning.
FRMD8 is annotated in vertebrates as a cytosolic/peripheral membrane protein that stabilizes rhomboid/iRhom proteins at the cell surface and regulates signaling.

No explicit catalytic reaction, cofactor, or enzyme activity was retrieved; the sequence is therefore best characterized as a nonenzymatic regulatory/scaffold protein, while absence of an annotation is not proof of inactivity.
Sequence-derived properties: 471 aa, approximately 52.23 kDa, theoretical pI 5.52, predicted net charge at pH 7 of approximately -12.45, GRAVY -0.377.

entities.name: RHBDF1/RHBDF2
observations: FRMD8 interacts with iRhom1/RHBDF1 and iRhom2/RHBDF2 and promotes their cell-surface stability by limiting endolysosomal degradation, according to reviewed mammalian annotations.

entities.name: Canonical Wnt signaling
observations: FRMD8 is annotated as a negative regulator of canonical Wnt signaling, possibly by affecting AXIN1 recruitment to LRP6.

entities.name: ADAM17 ligand shedding
observations: Through stabilization of iRhom proteins, FRMD8 participates in ADAM17-dependent shedding of TNF, AREG, HBEGF, and TGFA in mammalian annotations.
